_comment: Shared by sdk-python/tests/test_image_builder_parity.py and sdk-typescript/tests/image-builder-parity.test.ts: the same builder renders the same Dockerfile and request in both SDKs. Each "refused" case is a BadRequestError with its message in both SDKs ("tsError" where TypeScript names the argument in camelCase). Sources: "registry", "dockerfile" or "debianSlim" (null = the default series).

cases.name: env names retain step order even for integer keys
cases.dockerfile:
FROM alpine
ENV b="1"
ENV 2="2"
ENV a="3"

request.dockerfile:
FROM alpine
ENV b="1"
ENV 2="2"
ENV a="3"

cases.name: registry ref with U+001C and U+0085
Dockerfile ending in U+FEFF keeps it
commands with U+001C
cases.dockerfile:
FROM alpine
RUN ls
RUN echo hi

request.dockerfile:
FROM alpine
RUN ls
RUN echo hi

cases.name: packages with U+0085
cases.dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12
RUN python -m pip install 'numpy>=1.26' requests

request.dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12
RUN python -m pip install 'numpy>=1.26' requests

cases.name: debian slim at the default series
cases.dockerfile:
FROM python:3.13-slim-bookworm
RUN apt-get update
RUN apt-get install -y gcc gfortran build-essential
RUN pip install --upgrade pip
RUN echo 'debconf debconf/frontend select Noninteractive' | debconf-set-selections

request.dockerfile:
FROM python:3.13-slim-bookworm
RUN apt-get update
RUN apt-get install -y gcc gfortran build-essential
RUN pip install --upgrade pip
RUN echo 'debconf debconf/frontend select Noninteractive' | debconf-set-selections

cases.name: debian slim with layers
cases.dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12-slim-bookworm
RUN apt-get update
RUN apt-get install -y gcc gfortran build-essential
RUN pip install --upgrade pip
RUN echo 'debconf debconf/frontend select Noninteractive' | debconf-set-selections
RUN python -m pip install 'numpy>=1.26'
WORKDIR /app

request.dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12-slim-bookworm
RUN apt-get update
RUN apt-get install -y gcc gfortran build-essential
RUN pip install --upgrade pip
RUN echo 'debconf debconf/frontend select Noninteractive' | debconf-set-selections
RUN python -m pip install 'numpy>=1.26'
WORKDIR /app

cases.name: user, cmd and entrypoint
cases.dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12
USER daytona
ENTRYPOINT ["/bin/sh", "-c"]
CMD ["echo \"hi\"", " padded "]

request.dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12
USER daytona
ENTRYPOINT ["/bin/sh", "-c"]
CMD ["echo \"hi\"", " padded "]

cases.name: env values are literal: $ is escaped, quotes and backslashes as in JSON
cases.dockerfile:
FROM alpine
ENV DOL="\$PATH"
ENV BRACE="\${HOME}/x"
ENV Q="a\"b\\c\\\$d"
ENV U="é  "

request.dockerfile:
FROM alpine
ENV DOL="\$PATH"
ENV BRACE="\${HOME}/x"
ENV Q="a\"b\\c\\\$d"
ENV U="é  "
